summary: legal checked in 6 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Continue the existing SearchWoot launch-readiness evidence bundle. Keep the product private and rights outreach unsent; 0/4 checklist tasks are closed. Next action is dated read-only evidence for rights, data flow, retention, consent/GA4, vendors, incidents, accuracy, and rollback.

Risk disposition: blocked for SearchWoot public beta, full launch, alert expansion, affiliate use, or advertising. Evidence: Woot documentation establishes API access but not rights to store, derive, cache, display, alert on, or monetize deal and price-history data; current public terms restrict those uses. Human counsel is required for upstream rights, jurisdictional privacy treatment, and future affiliate or advertising use. Keep the product private and preview-only; keep rights outreach unsent pending counsel review and owner authorization.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 tasks closed and 4 remain open. Existing API, terms, support, repository/configuration, privacy, cookie-policy, and draft-terms evidence is insufficient to close any task. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only bundle covering field-level rights, deployed data flow and retention, deletion/correction/access, notification consent, consent withdrawal, GA4 settings, log fields, vendor coverage, incident/request procedures, accuracy/freshness controls, and rollback evidence. Do not send outreach or close tasks without direct evidence.

Data-use dispositions: Woot API deal and price-history data is blocked because written permission, field-level provenance, storage, derivative, caching, display, alert, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademark, image, price, affiliate, and advertising limits are missing; smallest next action is an internal counsel packet and human-counsel review. User alert rules and sync results are evidence_needed pending a read-only data-flow and retention table covering identifiers, Slack delivery, deletion, correction, access, consent, and unsubscribe behavior. GA4 analytics is evidence_needed pending deployed consent/withdrawal capture, GA4 property and data-sharing settings, retention settings, and jurisdictional review. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data are evidence_needed pending log-field, retention/access, vendor, incident, subpoena, and data-subject-request evidence.

Fleet disposition: ordinary reversible growth is conditional, not blocked solely by incomplete telemetry, provided it adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, new data collection, or cross-site behavior and preserves consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, affiliate, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries. Public exposure and security-sensitive releases remain blocked where compliance, security, or launch evidence is missing. Keep complicated.work, deadlymaracas.com, and driveford.net parked, private, preview-only, and unlaunched. Next evidence action for each is dated ownership, preview/build, compliance, security, measurement-boundary, rollback, and explicit-blocker evidence.

Compliance and data-quality evidence is a technical baseline, not certification: 36 sites pass, 17 fail, and 6 are unknown; analytics quality is yellow because some GA4/GSC sources are unavailable or erroring. Revenue evidence is limited to 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate Amazon commission for 2026-09-21, not site-attributable. Do not treat unavailable telemetry as zero or claim ROI, margin, forecast, or causal lift.
